activity.notes: Mihšihkinaahkwa, known as Little Turtle, was a prominent Myaamia leader from 1780 to 1809 according to the Myaamia community biography. The interval follows that documented leadership floruit rather than extending a formal chieftainship to his death in 1812. His military and diplomatic activity does not make him a hereditary supreme chief over every Miami community.
